mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`attraction_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_ticket v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_ticket sv ON v.id = sv.ticket_id WHERE v.attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND v.type = 1 AND v.status = 1
